description: Retrieval eval set for the project-02-rate-limiter corpus. Each question lists the source file(s) that a correct retrieval must surface; a retrieved chunk counts as a hit when its path matches any expected file.

questions.question: Where is the token bucket refill implemented for the in-memory limiter?
Where are the atomic Redis Lua scripts for the rate limiters defined?
How is the client identity resolved from the x-api-key header or the client IP?
Where are the Prometheus counters and the request duration histogram created?
Which file defines the RateLimitDecision interface that every limiter returns?
Where does createLimiter pick the limiter implementation based on algorithm and store kind?
How does the in-memory fixed window counter algorithm work?
Where does the sliding window log prune expired timestamps out of the trailing window?
Where are hop-by-hop headers stripped before forwarding a request to the upstream?
How is the gateway JSON config validated, for example that limit and windowSeconds are positive?
Where are per-API-key overrides merged into the route's default rate limit params?
Where is the X-Forwarded-For header appended when proxying to the upstream?
Which module starts the HTTP gateway server and matches routes by longest path prefix?
Where is the Redis-backed token bucket limiter that evaluates the Lua script?
How do the tests fake Redis EVAL behavior without a real Redis server?
Where is retryAfterSeconds computed when a token bucket request is denied?
Where do idle buckets and counters get swept so idle keys do not leak memory?
Where does the gateway run Redis scripts with EVALSHA and fall back to EVAL?
